overview: The Medford City Council addressed several resolutions concerning housing safety, teacher vaccine prioritization, recreational facilities, and road resurfacing. The council also approved a conditional food truck permit for a school PTO fundraiser and adopted the 2021 municipal election calendar.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Complaint Determination
items.summary: President Caraviello read a letter from the Massachusetts Attorney General's Office closing an Open Meeting Law complaint filed in June 2020 due to lack of a request for further review.

items.title: Board of Health COVID-19 Vaccine Rollout Updates
items.summary: Councilors expressed disappointment that the Board of Health Director was not present to provide a requested weekly COVID-19 vaccine update and asked that representation be ensured for subsequent meetings.

items.title: Condolences: John Spike Lawless
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of retired Cambridge firefighter John "Spike" Lawless.

items.title: Tenant Complaint and Inspection Procedures
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Housing Subcommittee requesting updates from city administration and departments on procedures for reporting health and safety issues in rental housing.

items.title: Alpha Management Health and Safety Issues
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration and inspectional departments address tenant-reported health and safety issues at 53–63 Fellsway West.

items.title: FAA Airplane Noise Comments
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the city administration to submit public comments to the FAA regarding airplane noise relief before the March 15 deadline, with copies forwarded to Massport and the CAC.

items.title: CARES Act Expenditure Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from city administration on the allocation of CARES Act funding for contact tracing, vaccination, and other COVID-19 expenses.

items.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Prioritization for Teachers
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging state and federal leadership to prioritize educators for COVID-19 vaccination, amended to include a request to the federal delegation for greater advance visibility into vaccine supplies.

items.title: Tennis Court Retrofitting for Pickleball
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city retrofit tennis courts for pickleball use and referred the matter to the Subcommittee on Youth and Recreation Affairs.

items.title: Recycled Asphalt Road Resurfacing Pilot
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration to develop a pilot program utilizing recycled asphalt to resurface city streets.

items.title: 2021 Municipal Election Calendar
items.summary: Approved the City of Medford 2021 municipal election calendar as presented by the city clerk.

items.title: Food Truck License: Andrews Middle School PTO Fundraiser
items.summary: Approved a food truck license application for an Andrews Middle School PTO fundraiser on March 3, 2021, with the condition that no customer data be retained or used for future solicitation.

items.title: Committee Reports and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Accepted the Committee of the Whole report regarding the Q2 financial update and approved the meeting minutes from February 9 and February 16, 2021.
